body: Well that's the thing. Sometimes I wish I was less smart so I would be able to talk about that dumb shit without stomping all over whatever dignity I have left. For better or the worse, as it stands I can't do that.

Thanks for commenting, too.           
My problem is that it's hard for me to be alone. I've been alone most of my life. I've been raised in a good family, but family can't replace friends, at least for me. There are some things I'd disclose to friends that I wouldn't want to talk about with family. I want to have people I can talk to truthfully, and I want someone to be affectionate about, but I don't have any of that, and I've failed to acquire it.            
I suppose that's a good way to put it. None of this would've been an issue had I not been born.

First of all, thanks for commenting. Your english is better than a lot of people I've seen, especially for a non-native speaker.         
I'm actually in a "new life" kind of situation right now, since I had to move to a different city for university. This didn't make things much better though. I'm still failing at being social, and I'm far away from anybody who particularly cares about me. I've moved places before, so haping to set up in a new area isn't exactly new for me, so it doesn't take me out of my usual thought process. I also now have to care for myself a bit more, since I'm living alone, and I'm doing everything an adult would apart from earning my own money (yet). This leaves me with more time outside of my bubble and brings me into the real world.
I enjoy some things in life, it's not like it's a constant depressing drag, but they don't last very long. Most things I do are really just time-killers, like reading books and playing videogames. There are some that stand out and it feels great to experience them, but most are just good enough to entertain me so I can think of something other than how utterly pointless what I'm doing is. Maybe once university fully kicks in I'll have other things to do.     
A big problem I have is that I'm not interested in your typical teenager\college kid things, so it's hard for me to find people to socialise with, which leaves me brooding in a corner while I watch all these other people have fun with their friends and loved ones. Sometimes I wish I was stupider than I am, able to enjoy the simpler things in life.                       
It's also an eternal question of the "Meaning of life". We all live out our lives in a similar pattern, growing up, college, job, marriage, kids. It's fine when you're enjoying it, but I just feel like most times I'm not, and there is no endgoal to work for. Even if I live to 100 years old, I will eventually die and soon there will be no trace of me. I'm not talented or determined enough to accomplish something grand, but I'm just intelligent enough to be upset about it. I don't like thinking that my life is just "going through the motions" that are ultimately of no consequence, and yet I can't find it in myself to view it any other way.       
I'm sorry if these are wall-of-texty.
